dialog.body: Utilities billing, this is Priya. How can I help you?
Yes, good afternoon. This is Ricardo Rivera. I am calling about my water and sewer payment. It was returned, bounced, from my bank, and I would like to know the status of it.
Okay, I can look into that. Can you give me the account name, or the service address on the bill?
The account is under Rivera, Ricardo. The address I would prefer not to say on this line, because I am on speakerphone, in the bank lobby. I am waiting my turn, so it is a little loud here.
That's fine. Do you have the account number from the top of the bill?
I do not have the bill with me. On the other hand, I have the name and my telephone, which is 401-555-0152. [crosstalk] Sorry, the teller is calling someone else, not me.
No problem. I'll try searching by name. One moment. [pause] I see a Rivera, Ricardo, with a returned payment noted on the account. Does that sound right?
Yes, that is it. So it is returned. But the money was in the account, I am quite sure. This is why I am here at the bank, to understand what happened. The bank says one thing, you say another.
I can only see that the payment came back unpaid. The reason code isn't something I can read from here. I can see the balance is still open.
Open, meaning I owe it still. On the other hand, nobody told me by mail or by phone. I find out only now. It is an annoying thing.
I understand. There may be a notice in the mail that hasn't reached you yet. I'm not seeing a late action posted on the account at this point.
Good, that is something. Also, I have a question. My daughter helps me with the bills, the computer things, the paperwork. She wants to be authorized to speak with you for me. How is this done?
We'd need an authorization from the account holder, in writing, with her name and contact information. I can have the form sent to you, or you can pick one up at the counter.
Send it, please. By email I am not good, so the regular mail is better. And the rest, the bounced payment, who can tell me exactly what to do now? You, or someone else?
Our billing supervisor can confirm the returned payment details and whether any fee was added. She's in a meeting right now. I can leave her a note and have someone call you back.
Yes, please call me back with an answer. The number I gave you, it is the correct one. [line breaks up] Sorry, did you hear?

I lost you for a second. I have 401-555-0152 on the account. I'll note that you want the status of the returned payment, whether anything is owed beyond the original amount, and the authorization form for your daughter.
Exactly. That is all correct. And please, today if it is possible. On the other hand, I understand you are busy, so tomorrow is also acceptable.
I'll mark it as a priority. You should hear from someone by tomorrow.
Thank you, Miss Priya. They are calling my number now at the bank, so I must go. Good afternoon.
Good afternoon, Mr. Rivera. Take care.
